2026_01_MIA_LV.headline: Las Vegas loses a central receiving piece as Miami brings a clean availability sheet
2026_01_MIA_LV.paragraph1: Miami reaches Las Vegas without a final injury designation, while the Raiders will be without Brock Bowers, removing one of the offense’s most important middle-of-the-field answers. Las Vegas can compensate by leaning on its run game and making Miami tackle consistently before asking the passing game to replace Bowers’ volume. The Dolphins, now operating with Malik Willis, need to stay efficient on early downs and avoid letting the Raiders control tempo through sustained rushing possessions.
2026_01_MIA_LV.model_rationale: Miami’s cleaner availability matters if it can stay on schedule, while Las Vegas must replace Bowers’ chain-moving role without becoming predictable in obvious passing situations.
